description: List the user's personal day-planner blocks (their own time-blocking schedule) visible on a given local date, with each block's done/not-done status for that date. Different from list_daily_tasks, which lists board tasks due today — this is the user's private schedule, not board tasks.

local_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD to view the plan for
